sections.title: Passage 1: How to spot a liar
sections.html:
deception

(noun). sự lừa dối

The magician's act was based on an elaborate deception of the audience.

feign injury

(verb). giả vờ bị thương

The soccer player was accused of feigning injury to get a penalty.

unscrupulous

(adjective). vô đạo đức

The unscrupulous salesman sold the old woman a broken car.

a devious spouse

(noun). một người vợ/chồng gian xảo

She was shocked to discover that her devious spouse had been secretly gambling their savings.

tell-tale signs

(noun). những dấu hiệu tố giác

The messy room was a tell-tale sign that he had been in a hurry.

verbal and non-verbal clues

(noun). các manh mối bằng lời nói và phi ngôn ngữ

The detective looked for both verbal and non-verbal clues from the suspect.

musculature of the face

(noun). cơ bắp của gương mặt

The study focused on the subtle movements in the musculature of the face when a person lies.

window to the soul

(noun). cửa sổ tâm hồn

They say the eyes are the window to the soul.

genuine emotions

(noun). những cảm xúc chân thật

The actor was so good that his sadness seemed like genuine emotions.

leak through

(verb). rò rỉ

The secret began to leak through the closed doors.

control facial expressions

(verb). kiểm soát nét mặt

He was a good poker player because he could control his facial expressions.

counterfeit grin

(noun). nụ cười giả

The salesman's counterfeit grin didn't fool anyone.

crow’s feet

(noun). vết chân chim

The old man's face was etched with laughter lines and crow's feet.

living things

(noun). các sinh vật sống

The biologist studied all kinds of living things, from plants to animals.

self-preservation

(noun). bản năng, xu hướng hoặc hành động tự nhiên để bảo vệ chính mình khỏi nguy hiểm hoặc tổn hại

The bear's aggressive behavior was a natural act of self-preservation.

catch deceit

(verb). phát hiện sự lừa dối

The lie detector test is used to catch deceit.

a survival skill

(noun). kỹ năng sinh tồn

The ability to find water in the desert is a vital survival skill.

successful liar

(noun). kẻ nói dối thành công

He was a successful liar who could trick anyone.

assess other people’s emotional states

(verb). đánh giá trạng thái cảm xúc của người khác

A good therapist must be able to assess other people's emotional states.

detect the physical cues

(verb). phát hiện các dấu hiệu thể chất

He was trained to detect the physical cues of a nervous person.

inadmissible

(adjective). không thể chấp nhận được

The evidence was ruled inadmissible in court.

mask sth

(verb). che giấu cái gì

He tried to mask his fear with a brave smile.

pull up

(verb). kéo lên

He had to pull up his eyebrows to show surprise.

be replicated at will

(verb). được tái tạo theo ý muốn

The new technology allows the product to be replicated at will.

the orbicularis oculi

(noun). cơ vòng mắt

The orbicularis oculi muscle helps a person to squint.

wrinkle

(verb). nhăn lại

She would wrinkle her nose when she was confused.

sections.title: Passage 2: Being Left-handed in a Right-handed World
sections.html:
wisdom

(noun). sự thông thái, lẽ phải thông thường

Ex: Native American wisdom was passed on from generation to generation.

undermine

(verb). làm suy yếu dần

Ex: Criticism just undermines their confidence.

temporary

(adjective). Tạm thời

Ex: The ceasefire will only provide a temporary solution to the crisis.

stem from

(verb). bắt nguồn từ

Ex: Their disagreement stemmed from a misunderstanding.

specialization

(noun). chuyên môn hóa

Ex: My main specialization was literature.

solely

(adverb). duy nhất

Ex: She was motivated solely by self-interest.

so-called

(adjective). Được gọi là

Ex: How have these so-called improvements helped the local community?

smooth

(adjective). trơn tru, suôn sẻ

Ex: They could not ensure a smooth transfer of political power.

sever

(verb). cắt, tách

Ex: Electricity cables have been severed by the storm.

revel

(verb). thích thú, hưởng thụ

Ex: Revelling in her freedom, she took a hotel room and stayed for several days.

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

reign

(verb). bao trùm, ảnh hưởng

Ex: Love reigned supreme in her heart.

pure

(adjective). thuần túy, tinh khiết

Ex: She laughed with pure joy.

predominantly

(adverb). phần lớn, chủ yếu

Ex: She works in a predominantly male environment.

potential

(noun). Tiềm năng, triển vọng

Ex: The European marketplace offers excellent potential for increasing sales.

possess

(verb). Sở hữu

Ex: I'm afraid this is the only suitcase I possess.

perhaps

(adverb). có thể

Ex: This is perhaps his best novel to date.

perception

(noun). Nhận thức

Ex: We have to change the public's perception that money is being wasted.

paralyze

(verb). làm cho tê liệt

Ex: The accident left him paralysed from the waist down.

overwhelming

(adjective). tràn ngập, làm choáng ngợp

Ex: There was overwhelming support for our policies.

investigate

(verb). Điều tra

Ex: Detectives are currently investigating possible links between the murders.

infant

(noun). Trẻ sơ sinh

Ex: She was seriously ill as an infant.

imitation

(noun). sự bắt chước

Ex: A child learns to talk by imitation.

frequently

(adverb). thường xuyên

Ex: It was a word he used frequently.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

Ex: Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.

excel

(verb). vượt trội

Ex: She has always excelled in foreign languages.

evolutionary

(adjective). tiến triển

Ex: The findings are a significant addition to evolutionary theory.

enable

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This new programme will enable older people to study at college.

emergent

(adjective). nổi lên, hiện ra

Ex: We have the flexibility to adjust our rates to meet emergent customer needs.

efficient

(adjective). Hiệu quả

Ex: We offer a fast, friendly and efficient service.

distribute

(verb). phân bổ, phân phối

Ex: Generous workspaces must be well distributed throughout the library.

disruption

(noun). Sự gián đoạn

Ex: The accident brought widespread disruption on the roads.

display

(verb). Trưng bày

Ex: She proudly displayed her certificate to her parents.

dexterity

(noun). sự khéo léo

Ex: You need good manual dexterity to be a dentist.

contradict

(verb). đối nghịch

Ex: All evening her husband contradicted everything she said.

concentration

(noun). sự tập trung

Ex: Tiredness affects your powers of concentration.

combine

(verb). kết hợp

Ex: Several factors had combined to ruin our plans.

capability

(noun). khả năng

Ex: Animals in the zoo have lost the capability of catching food for themselves.

associate

(verb). liên tưởng, liên kết

Ex: Most people immediately associate addictions with drugs, alcohol and cigarettes.

anesthetic

(noun). thuốc tê

Ex: The operation is performed under anesthetic.

analytical

(adjective). mang tính phân tích

Ex: an analytic approach to the problem Ex: She has a clear analytical mind.

advancement

(noun). sự tiến bộ

Ex: technological/economic/medical advancement

species

(noun). giống loài

Ex: Most of the known rhino species are West African.

seemingly

(adverb). có vẻ

Ex: It was a seemingly impossible task.

random

(adjective). Ngẫu nghiên

Ex: He grabbed a random pair of jeans and an old red shirt.

preference

(noun). Sự ưu tiên, ưa thích

Ex: Many people expressed a strong preference for the original plan.

vice versa

(adverb). Ngược lại

Ex: You can cruise from Cairo to Aswan or vice versa

probability

(noun). xác suất

Ex: There seemed to be a high probability of success.

minority

(noun). phần thiểu số

Ex: For a minority, the decision was a disappointment.

fetal

(adjective). thuộc về phôi thai

Ex: fetal abnormalities Ex: When pain medication is used, the fetal heartbeat has to be monitored.

entirely

(adverb). hoàn toàn

Ex: The experience was entirely new to me.

dominant

(adjective). ưu thế

Ex: The firm has achieved a dominant position in the world market.

certain

(adjective). nhất định, nào đó

Ex: You can choose to only watch certain kinds of movies.

hemisphere

(noun). Bán cầu

Ex: Countries in both the Northern and Southern hemispheres continue to treat the world's rivers, seas and oceans as dumping grounds.

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His film is heavily influenced by other film-makers.

settle

(verb). thu xếp, bố trí

Ex: It's been settled that we leave on the nine o'clock plane.

observation

(noun). sự quan sát

Ex: Most information was collected by direct observation of the animals' behaviour.

prevalent

(adjective). phổ biến

Ex: These prejudices are particularly prevalent among people living in the North.

political

(adjective). Mang tính chính trị

Ex: The police force is facing intense political pressure to reopen the investigation.

occupation

(noun). nghề nghiệp

Ex: Please state your name, age and occupation below.

composer

(noun). người soạn nhạc

Ex: Verdi was a prolific composer of operas.

acknowledge

(verb). Công nhận

Ex: She refuses to acknowledge the need for reform.

unique

(adjective). đặc biệt, độc nhất

Ex: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.

theory

(noun). Giả thuyết; học thuyết

Ex: He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.

suffer

(verb). chịu đựng

Ex: The company suffered huge losses in the last financial year.

state

(verb). phát biểu, tuyên bố

Ex: The facts are clearly stated in the report.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

individual

(noun). cá nhân

Ex: The competition is open to both teams and individuals.

function

(noun). Chức năng

Ex: The club serves a useful function as a meeting place.

encounter

(verb). chạm trán, gặp gỡ

Ex: We encountered a number of difficulties in the first week.

elaborate

(verb). nói thêm, giải thích

Ex: She said she was resigning, but refused to elaborate on her reasons for doing so.

discovery

(noun). khám phá

Ex: New scientific discoveries are being made all the time.

damage

(noun). tổn hại

Ex: The fire has caused severe damage to the building.

hypothesize

(verb). giả thiết hóa

Ex: We can only hypothesize that the cases we know about are typical.

determine

(verb). Quyết định

Ex: Upbringing plays an important part in determining a person's character.

biologist

(noun). nhà sinh vật học

Ex: He plans to hire a wildlife biologist to help him understand better the dynamics at work.

speculate

(verb). giả sử

Ex: We all speculated about the reasons for her resignation.

movement

(noun). Chuyển động

Ex: Loose clothing gives you greater freedom of movement.

fetus

(noun). thai nhi

Ex: How well a woman and the fetus do during pregnancy depends upon the type of heart problem.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

publish

(verb). công bố

Ex: He works for a company that publishes reference books.

process

(verb). xử lí

Ex: My brain slowly processed the fact that I was free to leave.

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

Ex: He played a major role in setting up the system.

intensely

(adverb). mãnh liệt, dữ dội

Ex: She disliked him intensely.

institute

(noun). viện

Ex: The report was compiled by Germany's five leading economic research institutes

correlation

(noun). tương quan

Ex: There is a direct correlation between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

confirm

(verb). Xác nhận

Ex: His guilty expression confirmed my suspicions.

predate

(verb). xảy ra trước

Ex: Few of the town's fine buildings predate the earthquake of 1755.

origin

(noun). Nguồn gốc

Ex: This particular custom has its origins in Wales.

gesture

(noun). điệu bộ, cử chỉ

Ex: They communicated entirely by gesture.

emerge

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: The swimmer emerged from the lake. Ex: The facts behind the scandal are sure to emerge eventually.

dominate

(verb). Thống trị

Ex: The train crash dominated the news.

identical

(adjective). y hệt

Ex: Her dress is almost identical to mine. Ex: identical twins

genetic

(adjective). thuộc về gen, di truyền

Ex: This is a form of genetic modification.

factor

(noun). Nhân tố

Ex: The result will depend on a number of different factors.

determination

(noun). sự quyết định

Ex: The determination of policy is not your business - your job is to implement it.

widely

(adverb). xa, rộng rãi

Ex: The company is widely acknowledged as a leader in the field.

expert

(noun). Chuyên gia

Ex: According to our panel of leading industry experts, a downturn is inevitable.

accept

(verb). chấp nhận

Ex: The judge refused to accept his evidence.

functional

(adjective). thuộc về chức năng

Ex: These units played a key functional role in the military operation.

devise

(verb). nghĩ ra, sáng chế

Ex: A new system has been devised to control traffic in the city.

base on

(phrase). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

access

(noun). sự tiếp cận

Ex: They are seeking increased access to markets overseas.

sections.title: Passage 3: What is a dinosaur?
sections.html:
prominent

(adjective). nổi bật

Ex: The church tower was a prominent feature in the landscape.

bear

(verb). mang

Ex: He was badly wounded in the war and still bears the scars.

terrible

(adjective). tồi tệ

Ex: He had suffered terrible injuries.

derive

(verb). bắt nguồn từ

Ex: The story derives from a very common folktale.

prehistoric

(adjective). thuộc về thời tiền sử

Ex: Painting originated in prehistoric times.

skeletal

(adjective). thuộc bộ xương

Ex: Skeletal remains of the earliest dinosaurs are rare.

classification

(noun). Sự phân loại

Ex: Hotels are listed in four classifications from economy to deluxe.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

anatomy

(noun). Giải phẫu học; Cấu trúc cơ thể

Ex: An understanding of human anatomy is important to a dancer.

reptile

(noun). Động vật bò sát

Ex: There was a fashion for keeping reptiles as pets.

palaeontologist

(noun). nhà cổ sinh vật học

Ex: No palaeontologist has any clue as to what a living dinosaur actually looked like.

extinct

(adjective). tuyệt chủng

Ex: The red squirrel is in danger of becoming extinct in England.

ancestor

(noun). Tổ tiên

Ex: His ancestors had come to America from Ireland.

evolve

(verb). Tiến hoá

Ex: The three species evolved from a single ancestor.

varied

(adjective). gồm nhiều loại khác nhau

Ex: With its varied climate, the country attracts both winter and summer sports enthusiasts.

situate

(verb). đặt vị trí

Ex: The restaurant is situated near the Hudson River.

reflect

(verb). phản ánh, cho thấy bản chất của

Ex: Our newspaper aims to reflect the views of the local community.

limb

(noun). chi

Ex: The accident victims mostly had injuries to their lower limbs.

extraordinary

(adjective). phi thường

Ex: The president took the extraordinary step of apologizing publicly for his behaviour!

extend

(verb). kéo dài, mở rộng

Ex: The Sahara Desert extends for miles.

dominate

(verb). Thống trị

Ex: The train crash dominated the news.

pelvis

(noun). xương chậu

Ex: Maintain this relationship between your pelvis and spine throughout each exercise.

skull

(noun). hộp sọ

Ex: The biggest of the bones looked like a piece of skull.

vertically

(adverb). một cách thẳng đứng

Ex: The cliffs rose up vertically out of the water.

significantly

(adverb). 1 cách đáng kể

Ex: Profits have increased significantly over the past few years.

sharply

(adverb). sắc bén

Ex: a sharply pointed nail Ex: They are oriented either to the cathedral and the sharply angled, gorgeously finished campanile or to the plaza with olive trees and other symbolic plants.

identification

(noun). sự nhận diện

Ex: Each product has a number for easy identification.

dislocation

(noun). sự làm trật khớp, sự trật khớp

Ex: a dislocation of the shoulder

differentiate

(verb). Tách biệt rõ ràng

Ex: I can't differentiate one variety from another.

beneath

(adverb). bên dưới

Ex: The boat sank beneath the waves.

align

(verb). Xếp thẳng hàng

Ex: Make sure the shelf is aligned with the top of the cupboard.

hind

(adjective). phía hậu

Ex: a hind leg Ex: One of the animals filled the screen, rearing up on its hind legs and seemingly staring back at her with dark eyes.

rear

(noun). Bộ phận đằng sau, phía sau

Ex: We walked round to the rear of the house.

purpose

(noun). mục đích

Ex: Our campaign's main purpose is to raise money.

pattern

(noun). Khuôn mẫu

Ex: Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.

orientation

(noun). sự định hướng

Ex: The church has an east-west orientation.

divide

(verb). Phân chia

Ex: The questions divide into two categories: easy and hard.

comprise

(verb). bao gồm

Ex: The committee is comprised of representatives from both the public and private sectors.

basis

(noun). Nền tảng

Ex: The basis of a good marriage is trust.

tiny

(adjective). rất nhỏ

Ex: We come from a tiny little town in upstate New York.

huge

(adjective). to lớn

Ex: A huge crowd had gathered in the square.

omnivorous

(adjective). (Dành cho động vật) Ăn tạp

Ex: Pigs are omnivorous animals.

mighty

(adjective). hùng mạnh

Ex: In the 1600s, this family was among the mightiest in the kingdom.

herbivorous

(adjective). (Dành cho động vật) Ăn cỏ

Ex: The iguanadon was a herbivorous dinosaur.

estimate

(verb). Ước lượng

Ex: The satellite will cost an estimated £400 million.

carnivorous

(adjective). (Dành cho động vật) Ăn thịt

Ex: Farmed cod and haddock are carnivorous and need to be fed other sea fish.

armoured

(adjective). bọc sắt, được trang bị vũ khí

Ex: a horse capable of carrying a fully armoured knight

stiffly

(adverb). cứng nhắc

Ex: The key turned stiffly in the lock.

classify

(verb). Phân loại

Ex: Patients are classified into three categories.

period

(noun). kỳ, thời kỳ

Ex: The project will run for a six-month trial period.

presence

(noun). sự hiện hữu

Ex: Her presence during the crisis had a calming effect.

differ

(verb). khác, không giống

Ex: French differs from English in this respect.

unique

(adjective). đặc biệt, độc nhất

Ex: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.

occur

(verb). xảy ra

Ex: Three major events occurred in my life that year.

highly

(adverb). rất

Ex: The US car market is highly competitive.

gait

(noun). dáng đi

Ex: I could always recognize her by the briskness of her gait.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

Ex: Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.

efficient

(adjective). Hiệu quả

Ex: We offer a fast, friendly and efficient service.

combination

(noun). Sự phối hợp

Ex: His treatment was a combination of surgery, radiation and drugs.

typically

(adverb). điển hình

Ex: Typically, the contracts were for five years.

range

(verb). trải dài

Ex: Accommodation ranges from tourist class to luxury hotels.

mere

(adjective). ít, nhỏ không đáng kể

Ex: It took her a mere 20 minutes to win.

tail

(noun). đuôi

Ex: The dog wagged its tail excitedly.

balance

(verb). giữ thăng bằng

Ex: How long can you balance on one leg?
